name: Campos dos Goytacazes

queries.query: Campos dos Goytacazes official cadastral parcel map GIS cadastro imobiliário geoprocessamento municipality
queries.result: Found the official municipal Geo portal, the Municipal Finance cadastral/IPTU portal, and the official municipal Planta On-line references. The Geo portal identifies a municipal geoprocessing custodian and publishes maps/data pages, but no anonymous parcel feature service returning a safe native ID and polygon was verified.

queries.query: Campos dos Goytacazes prefeitura cadastro imobiliário mapa de parcelas lote geoprocessamento serviço oficial
queries.result: Confirmou-se a Prefeitura/Setor de Geoprocessamento como custodiante municipal de mapas e dados, e a Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda como custodiante do Cadastro Imobiliário e IPTU. O portal Geo publica mapas temáticos e o Mapa 08 - Parcelamento do Plano Diretor, mas não foi verificado um endpoint público anônimo com identificador nativo seguro e geometria parcelária.

source.provider: Prefeitura Municipal de Campos dos Goytacazes, Setor de Geoprocessamento / Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda
source.serviceType: Official municipal geoprocessing map/data catalog and municipal cadastral/IPTU services; no public anonymous parcel feature service confirmed
safeFieldsRequested: stable native parcel ID if publicly exposed
source.scopeNote: The municipal Geo portal exposes public map/data pages and a Plano Diretor 2020 Mapa 08 - Parcelamento PDF, which is a planning map rather than a parcel feature response. The Municipal Finance portal and IPTU gateway describe cadastral/tax services, but access is account/property-number oriented and no safe parcel geometry endpoint was exposed. No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

verifiedSample.result: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained; no GeoJSON sample retained. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Campos dos Goytacazes municipal geoprocessing portal and Municipal Finance cadastral/IPTU services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal custodian and public map/catalog services verified; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity and citywide polygon access unverified.
